fieldValues.title: How should a change to a repository's structure be recorded?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (4. Structure that stays stable as it grows), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Git history only.
- B. A snapshot record of the navigation before and after each change.
- C. A navigation diff computed on demand (srs repo diff over the outline).
- D. A change note in the repository's root, written by whoever changed it.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: What the owner needs when comparing structures over time (vignette ac5974c6: record the old structure, then what changed).
fieldValues.next_action: Take the uncommitted muSrs restructure and try recording it each way.
